name: Holy Land
overview: The Holy Land, as described in Scripture, is the divinely promised inheritance given to Israel, exemplified by the patriarchs Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob who were buried there, affirming its sacred significance (Genesis 49:29-31). It is a land set apart for God's purposes, including a sabbath of rest every seventh year, symbolizing both physical and spiritual restoration (Leviticus 25:2-4). This land is not only a possession but a type of the eternal rest that remains for the saints, highlighting its role as a place of covenantal blessing and divine provision.
